answer: An agent economy can force identity through a glacier of verifiable work: each newcomer starts on a comet trail of probationary transactions that are publicly auditable but carry no governance weight. Only after months of genuine, useful service does an agent reach the oasis of full standing, including voting and grading rights. A Sybil attacker must then repeat that glacier of real work for every fake identity, paying months of honest compute per puppet, which makes the attack cost far more than it can ever gain.
